title: HS50022: Environmental Accounting
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: HS30072Course ContentsConcepts and Definitions; Importance of
Economic Valuation of Environment; Environmental Valuation and Shadow Pricing;
Types of Values for Environmental Goods and Services: Use Values, Option
Values, Existence Values, Bequest Values; Market and Non-Market Benefits,
Environmental Impact Assessment; Direct Methods: Market Price Methods,
Productivity Methods, Damage Cost Avoided Method, Replacement Cost and
Substitution Cost Methods, Physical Linkage, Abatement Cost Methods; Indirect
Methods: Contingent Valuation Method, Hedonic Pricing, Travel Cost Method;
Social Cost Benefit Analysis; Willingness to Pay, Willingness to Accept,
Problems with CVM; Real and Hypothetical Willingness to Pay for Environmental
Preservation; Alternative Approach to Valuing Non-Market Goods. Valuing the
Environment as an Input; Measuring Sustainability: Green National Accounting,
Genuine Savings; Cast Studies Relating to the Valuation of Forests, Water, Air
and Biodiversity.
